characterizations.result_summary: Measured number-average molecular weight, weight-average molecular weight and polydispersity index of all polymers, with PDI ranging from 1.09 to 1.28.
Measured glass transition temperature, melting temperature and isotropic transition temperature of all polymers.
Confirmed chemical structure of monomers and polymers, and monitored photocrosslinking reaction of chalcone moiety.
Confirmed chemical structure of monomers and successful polymerization of methacrylic function.
Evaluated thermal stability of all polymers, showing two-stage decomposition above 250 °C.

The polymers were synthesized by free-radical solution addition polymerization from the respective monomers using AIBN as an initiator in THF at $6 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$for 48 h. The typical procedure for the synthesis of polymer ia is as follows: The monomer ia (400 mg, 0.67 mol) and AIBN (2 wt %) were dissolved in dry THF (5 mL) and gentle steam ofnitrogen purged into the solution. The solution was kept in an oil bath at $6 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$for 48 h. Then, the solution was cooled and poured into excess of methanol to precipitate the product. The crude polymer thus obtained was represipitated twice using chloroform and methanol. The purified polymer was dried at $4 5 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$under vacuum for 48 h to afford yellow colored solid. The remaining Ib–IIc was also prepared by adopting similar procedure as of Ia.
